Anya M.: morning folks — noticed overnight allocation in ap-northeast1 gave h100 nodes but AMIs baked for h200 (RDMA driver mismatch). anyone available to flip to a compatible sku or swap images? @vendor-ops
Omar R.: Ugh. Did we reserve a specific sku in TF? I can check quota and reservation mapping.
Anya M.: not in TF, vendor provisioned a standby slice. Only thing we have is tenant tag. saw boot error in onboarding logs: `driver: missing rdma-compat` on node-boot.
Kevin L.: short-term we can push a fallback package that disables RDMA (big perf hit) to keep jobs alive. long-term we should ask vendor for h200 or request a custom AMI.
vendor-ops: Hi Anya — we can swap to h200 but lead time is ~3-5 hrs due to rack ops in ap-northeast. If you share the reservation id we can prioritize.
Anya M.: reservation id: res-8942. @standby-bot bumped priority; can someone confirm quota for h200? @Omar R.
Omar R.: Checking now. Quota looks sufficient but we need explicit regional SKU permission. Pinged infra-approval channel, ETA ~45m. if approval comes through vendor can start swap immediately.
standby-bot: [automated] Reservation res-8942 priority set to HIGH by Anya M. — ticket #INC-2026-112 created.
Kevin L.: if approval stalls, i'll prepare the fallback image. Bake command: ```./scripts/bake-ami --region ap-northeast1 --disable-rdma``` i'll open a PR in ~10m.
Anya M.: thanks — tagging @vendor-ops: can you confirm whether the swap requires node rebooting or can you hot-swap without interrupting running containers? :pray:
vendor-ops: hot-swap requires node reboot; we can do a rolling reboot to minimize impact. we'll coordinate windows and start swap once approval arrives.
Anya M.: got it. i'll follow up on infra-approval and leave the fallback PR as backup. thanks all :thumbsup:
